--src: Mathlib.Data.Semiquot
theorem isPure_iff {s : Semiquot α} : IsPure s ↔ ∃ a, s = pure a :=
  ⟨fun h => ⟨_, eq_pure h⟩, fun ⟨_, e⟩ => e.symm ▸ pure_isPure _⟩

  comp_map g h _ := funext <| fun c ↦ propext
    ⟨fun ⟨a, ⟨h₁, h₂⟩⟩ ↦ ⟨g a, ⟨⟨a, ⟨h₁, rfl⟩⟩, h₂⟩⟩,
     fun ⟨_, ⟨⟨a, ⟨h₁, h₂⟩⟩, h₃⟩⟩ ↦ ⟨a, ⟨h₁, show h (g a) = c from h₂ ▸ h₃⟩⟩⟩
  map_const := rfl

--src: Mathlib.Topology.Order
@[simp]
theorem nhds_discrete (α : Type*) [TopologicalSpace α] [DiscreteTopology α] : @nhds α _ = pure :=
  le_antisymm (fun _ s hs => (isOpen_discrete s).mem_nhds hs) pure_le_nhds

--src: Mathlib.Order.Filter.Ultrafilter
theorem eq_pure_of_finite [Finite α] (f : Ultrafilter α) : ∃ a, f = pure a :=
  (eq_pure_of_finite_mem finite_univ univ_mem).imp fun _ ⟨_, ha⟩ => ha
